items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 6:1
items.html: When the Mochin of ZA, namely HB and HG, as above in Answer 5, come by way of the Yesodot of AVI — where HB are drawn from the upper joints of the arms, namely the RTS within them, clothed in AVI Ilain, and HG are drawn from the lower joints of the arms of AA, namely their ends, which are the aspect of Yeshsut, as above in Answer 5 — they come by way of the Yesod as well, in the same manner of their division above. For the Yesod, too, divides into RTS: the two upper joints are the Yesod, and the lower joint is the Atara, as is known. Therefore the two upper Mochin, HB, clothe in the Yesod in the manner of their being drawn from the two upper joints of the arms of AA, and the lower Mochin, which is HG, clothes in the Atara of the Yesod, which is the lower third of the Yesod, like the two shoulders, which are the lower thirds of the arms of AA.
